Description: Storane is the daughter of Beler and Mada, and shares her parents with Respendial and Attaces. Young and attentive to the world beyond her household, she resents being spoken for before she has heard a proposal herself. Her family ties matter deeply, but loyalty does not make every offered alliance equally wise. She wants to know what a marriage or political promise would require from each side and what room it leaves for her own judgement. Ordinary conversation brings out her curiosity and warmth; talk of obligations makes her more deliberate. She may question a relative without wishing to disgrace the family, and she prefers an honest disagreement to consent extracted through ceremony. Her mother's concern for household security is familiar to her, yet she also wants opportunities that caution alone may close off. She hopes to keep the affection of her parents and brothers while gaining a voice that is not merely an echo of theirs. The possibility of being valued only for the bargain her name can secure troubles her more than the absence of public praise.
